page.content:
Nederlander barn on 51st Street that has housed Wicked since 2003.

How Gershwin Theatre connects

  • Work: Wicked — Wicked has played the Gershwin Theatre since 2003.
  • Faction: The Nederlander Organization — The Nederlander Organization operates the Gershwin Theatre.
  • Location: Broadway theatre district — The Gershwin Theatre stands on 51st Street in the district.

What is Gershwin Theatre?

The Gershwin Theatre is the largest Broadway house, a Nederlander theatre on 51st Street that has been Wicked's New York home since the musical opened.

Key threads lead to Wicked, The Nederlander Organization and Broadway theatre district.
